title: Ensemble-contextual nonlinear same-input escape vs remote-steering no-signalling
falsified_claim: A remotely selectable ensemble-decomposition-sensitive nonlinear local probability rule can provide a same-local-input PDT deviation while retaining standard steering and no-signalling.
surviving_boundary: Any viable PDT deviation must explicitly change a physical coordinate such as dynamics, admissible effects, global state/composition, steering structure, or another independently testable law.
